mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 1.0% compresses risk-free rates, reducing equity discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through consistent monetary easing.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 1.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals labor market deterioration that precedes corporate earnings contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS > 2.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening that suppresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0 and FEDFUNDS > 2.5, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
